_README: Extra animation clips for the bot rig: clip name -> file, loaded by
loadBotAnimations() in src/main.js at boot, before the first Bot is built.
Recognised names are listed in BOT_CLIP_NAMES (src/bots.js); anything else is ignored.
These came from mixamo.com, exported as FBX, WITHOUT SKIN, and with In Place ticked on
every locomotion clip - the bots are moved by physics, so a clip carrying root motion
makes them slide. Death has no In Place option, so its root motion is kept as authored:
the bot code (feetCentre in src/bots.js) pins the average of the two feet to where it died,
so the feet stay put and the body folds down onto them; the hips still travel about 0.8 m.
Sources: Rifle Idle / Rifle Walk / Rifle Run / Strafe Left (Rifle Walk Strafe Left) /
Strafe Right (Rifle Walk Strafe Right) / Walking Backwards (While Aiming Rifle) /
Idle Crouching Aiming / Death From The Front / Rifle Crouch Walk In Place (CrouchWalk) /
Reloading Standing In Place (Reload) / Reload Rifle In Crouch (ReloadCrouch).
Reload and ReloadCrouch are UPPER-BODY ONLY: bots.js (UPPER_CLIPS, UPPER_BONES) reads just the
spine, neck, head and arm tracks, sampled at the reload's progress, and blends them over the
locomotion pose, so the legs keep walking through a reload. They are never run on the mixer.
CrouchWalk is in place like the other locomotion clips: its playback rate is its measured drift,
or CLIP_SPEED.CrouchWalk when no drift is found.
Retargeting is by track name and the rig is stock Mixamo, so no bone remapping is
needed - but three's FBXLoader strips the colon from 'mixamorig:Hips', so the loader
puts it back. Without that, every track binds to nothing and the clips silently do
nothing at all.
